theorem: For an ambient split H times N with Gamma_A(h,n)=Gamma_H(h)+Gamma_N(n), a supplied right inverse j_N of Gamma_N, literal observation P(h,n)=h, and any h with nonzero Gamma_H(h), the element (h,-j_N Gamma_H(h)) lies in ker Gamma_A while its literal observation has nonzero Gamma_H trace. Thus literal observation does not preserve the ambient gamma kernel. No physical leftover, quotient or source-selected correction is classified.
